title: christella khasiana
intro: Christella khasiana, commonly known as the Himalayan chain fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Thelypteridaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Christella khasiana include its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an antioxidant, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Christella khasiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
